subject.title: fix(queue): add guarded fresh DLQ recovery

question: Should this guarded recovery control be accepted as the permanent DLQ recovery path, with https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/pull/650 landed first and the initial production use performed as a monitored canary?
rationale: The implementation and isolated persistent proof are strong, but only the queue owner can approve the dependency order and intentional mutation of the hosted durable backlog.

options.title: Land prevention, then recover
options.body: Merge https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/pull/650 first, merge this PR afterward, and start with a small inspected production batch.

options.title: Merge but defer use
options.body: Merge the endpoint before the prevention PR but prohibit production recovery until the producer-side failure path is closed.

options.title: Pause the recovery control
options.body: Keep this PR open until the producer fix has operated long enough to reassess whether manual backlog recovery is still needed.

recommendation.title: Land prevention, then recover
recommendation.body: Merge https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/pull/650 first, merge this PR afterward, and start with a small inspected production batch.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work introduced the durable publication DLQ and its operational control boundary.
